features: Hide projects from the sidebar and use the visibility toggle to show hidden projects. Projects with recovered editor drafts remain visible.
Use Ctrl+P to search files with ignore rules, or Ctrl+Shift+P to include ignored files. Existing custom shortcuts are preserved during upgrades.
Customize the workspace highlight border color and intensity, preview the result, or restore the theme default.
Project filters wrap onto multiple rows, and keyboard navigation reveals the active project in the sidebar.
fixes: Restore terminal focus when the application window becomes active and on initial load.
Trim trailing whitespace from terminal line selections and preserve drag anchors when scrollback is trimmed.
Keep the terminal cursor blinking when reduced motion is enabled, and remove the highlight border from active sidebar view buttons.

features: 支持隐藏侧边栏项目，并通过显示开关查看隐藏项目；有恢复草稿的项目会保持可见。
Ctrl+P 按忽略规则搜索文件，Ctrl+Shift+P 搜索时包含被忽略的文件；升级时保留已有自定义快捷键。
支持自定义工作区高亮边框颜色和强度，可预览效果或恢复主题默认值。
项目筛选按钮支持自动换行，通过键盘切换项目时会自动滚动显示当前项目。
fixes: 修复应用窗口激活和首次加载时终端焦点未恢复的问题。
终端按行选择时去除行尾空白，回滚内容裁剪后保留拖选锚点。
系统开启减少动态效果时保持终端光标闪烁，并移除侧边栏当前视图按钮的高亮边框。
